# Operation Support Matrix (Phase 4C.4 – 4C.5)

**Scope**: All **514 IR shards** (`data/ir_shards/*.json`), **15,398 compiled cards**, **36,422 abilities**, **51,734 clauses** (generated by `scripts/audit_514_ops_conditions.mjs`).

## Summary Metrics

| Metric | Count / Value |
| --- | ---: |
| IR Shards Scanned | 514 |
| Total Cards | 15,398 |
| Total Abilities | 36,422 |
| Total Clauses / Operation Instances | 51,734 |
| Unique IR Operations | 288 |
| Implemented Unique Operations (`engine/ops/index.js`) | 120 |
| Unimplemented Unique Operations | 168 |
| **Supported Operation Instances** | **49,150 / 51,734 (95.01%)** |

## Top Unimplemented Operations (Explicit `UNIMPLEMENTED` Status)

These 168 rare/specialized operations account for the remaining **2,584 instances (4.99%)** and fail closed with `UNSUPPORTED`:
`DECK_OR_HAND_ACTION` (233), `ACTIVATE_FLASH` (178), `ADVENT_PAY` (176), `UNPREVENTABLE` (131), `CONTINUE_BATTLE` (105), `CHANGE` (104), `MODIFY_EFFECT` (81), `COUNT_OPERATION` (79), `CAST_MAGIC_FREE` (76), `PREVENT_WHEN_SUMMONED` (76), `ACTIVATE_EFFECT_ACTION` (59), `DECK_ACTION` (50), `CONTRACT_ADVENT_RULE` (42), `SET_BURST` (40), `FORMAT_MARKER` (36), `TOKEN_DEPLOYMENT` (35), `MODIFY_EFFECT_VALUE` (34), `ACTIVATE_CARD_EFFECT` (33), `MIRAGE_OPERATION` (30), `TRIGGERED_WATCHER` (29).
